text.p: Diego Maradona was in hospital again on Friday just days after being rushed to a clinic after falling ill on a Chilean television chat show.
"It's not serious, it's just a check-up," an official at the exclusive Buenos Aires hospital said. She said Maradona had been admitted during the night but would give no further details.

Argentina's 1986 World Cup winning captain broke out in a cold sweat on a Chilean chat show on Monday night after dancing a tango with former Miss Universe Cecilia Bolocco. He was taken to hospital and diagnosed with high blood pressure.
Maradona returned the next day to Buenos Aires, where local media reported he spent the night dancing at a nightclub.
